reviewScope: Independent source and saved after-state evidence review for the scoped V7 unpublished preview repair; not publication approval.

independence.method: Recomputed local byte hashes, compared complete saved API before/after manifests and payloads, checked rollback bindings, then inspected root-performed browser receipts and report consistency. No test suite rerun.

independentlyVerifiedSource.reviewedMutationScope: Only the three theme files; no product, price, review or source translation record payloads.

browserEvidence.desktopEnglish: Complete collection heading and similar-link text/aria/title; unsupported social-proof wrapper absent; Adult / 4XL / Green, $26.99 and enabled Add retained.
browserEvidence.mobileEnglish: 390px without overflow; same exact variant, price and enabled Add retained.
browserEvidence.realCart: One actual mobile Add recorded variant 46512190292065, Adult 4XL / Green, quantity 1, $26.99; only test item removed, final cart 0 and zero rows.
browserEvidence.collectionJourney: Actual click confirmed family-tops URL and heading; return retained destination and generic Back to results fallback. The initial no-navigation click was not counted as pass.
browserEvidence.positiveReviewHoldout: Before and after receipts retain one existing 5.00 / 1-review badge; actual badge click scrolled Customer Reviews to 29.8125px from viewport top. No review authenticity inference.
browserEvidence.localized: Spanish, Japanese and Arabic mobile receipts show complete context labels, localized collection paths, absent unsupported fallback and no overflow; Arabic desktop receipt records no overflow or visible broken images.
browserEvidence.consoleLimit: Browser log samples, not server or payment-provider telemetry.

generator.isolatedActualBuildMap: PASS for 105 real templates, missing/raw fallback and unrelated placeholders.
generator.normalCli: BLOCKED by pre-existing missing deep_translator in bundled Python; isolated test does not certify normal CLI.

findings.originalFinding: Repairing the map activated replacement-string interpolation in formatBackToResultsLabel, corrupting literal dollar sequences; the inline callback alone did not cover back-navigation text/aria/title.
findings.resolution: The sole global replacement now uses () => sanitizedLabel. Independent execution of the actual function preserved $&, $$, $` and $' literally, while the rollback function failed.
findings.scopeExpansion: Root added only assets/global.js and its checksum-bound rollback; reviewer made no candidate edits.

reportConsistency: READBACK and current V7 source summaries agree on three incremental files, 19 cumulative files, 508 preserved predecessor files, 61 MAIN differences, preview-only acceptance and stated limits. No reliance on interim final-check or canonical status.
remainingLimits: Existing Japanese and Arabic size hints still include English; Arabic collection translations retain underscore punctuation. Broader localization and collection classification remain open.
Positive-review buyer acceptance covers one existing product, not catalog-wide review quality or authenticity.
Provider acceptance remains unverified; V7 performed no checkout or payment submission.
Publication, published buyer acceptance, post-release PageSpeed and conversion uplift are not established by this preview review.
Root owns pending canonical integration and final continuity checks; this verdict does not claim they passed.
nextAction: Root completes pending canonical/final validation and hands off the exact preview release. Owner Shopify Admin publication remains a separate prerequisite for live acceptance.
